name: big-number-hero
title: Big number hero
description: One figure as the picture: a huge number at the largest size its container allows, what it measures, a dated source and the action that follows.
docs: value is the figure, unit what it counts ("million litres", "years", "%"), label what it measures, and format takes options for Intl.NumberFormat, such as { maximumFractionDigits: 1 } or { style: "percent" }. The figure is set at the largest size its container allows, from a phone to a wide page: a short unit stays beside it, a longer one drops under it on a narrow screen. The heading holds the label and the final value as text from the first render. animate counts up from zero once, the first time the figure is on screen, using AnimatedNumber; duration is in seconds; under reduced motion, or without IntersectionObserver, the final value is simply there. source is words or { label, href }, asOf the day the figure was true (shown in a time element) and actions the buttons, the first of them solid. Pass locale and timeZone, and labels to translate the fixed words.
